## Default Permission

Sign-in over a loopback redirect and OS keychain storage for ci-auth.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-begin-loopback`
- `allow-await-loopback`
- `allow-cancel-loopback`
- `allow-secure-get`
- `allow-secure-set`
- `allow-secure-remove`
